$comment: Single source of configuration for the graph-first knowledge pipeline (raw + docs/specs -> Graphify -> Obsidian -> OKF). The .opencode/commands wiki commands (/generate-llm-wiki, /publish-llm-wiki), the second-brain-keeper agent and scripts/source_watch.py all read from here. To port this system to another repository, change these values only. There is no CI in this project — the OKF gate is validate.sh, run before /publish-llm-wiki.
$comment_document_conversion: Binary documents under source_root are converted to Markdown at out_dir/<root-slug> and extracted as an extra Graphify root staged at <stage_dir>/<stage_slug>. Conversion runs only in /generate-llm-wiki modes update and all. Per-file failures are non-blocking (CLI exit 1); CLI exit 2 (config/unsafe path/lock) is fatal. stage_slug must differ from every source-root staging slug.
$comment_extraction_mode: "standard" = graphify default semantic extraction (no --mode flag; graphify 0.9.71 offers only --mode deep). "deep" = aggressive INFERRED-edge extraction: more LLM tokens. Token-saving default: standard.
$comment_extraction_backend: RESOLVED on first run (graphify 0.9.53): backend 'deepseek' is the native OpenAI-compatible DeepSeek backend — env DEEPSEEK_API_KEY (set), base https://api.deepseek.com, default model deepseek-flash (matches the project model matrix). Resolved live with `opencode` + `graphify` installed, as the OTQ required.
$comment_deepen_scope: Integer N = deepen only the top N hubs (graphify god-nodes --top N); "all" rewrites every concept note each cycle (most LLM tokens). Token-saving default: 20.
$comment_publication_exclude: Repo-relative path prefixes that /publish-llm-wiki removes from the git index after staging. Prefixes, not globs. Derived extraction input is regenerable and must not be published.
